description: A10 Wave 7 — 200 Vietlish/interference review candidates. Fresh territory: question formation, existential 'have', time/date expressions, digital-life calques, food & dining, shopping, transportation, comparison & degree, numbers & quantities, direction & movement, negation, politeness & discourse, professional/academic register, false friends, kinship & address terms, redundancy patterns, connector/gerund errors. Deduped vs live(481) + waves 1-6(1065) = 1546-item denylist. Zero collisions.

entries.vietlish: inside the box have a gift
entries.natural: there's a gift inside the box
entries.sourcePattern: bên trong hộp có quà (existential calque)
entries.context: describing the contents of a box

entries.vietlish: this video has too many like
entries.natural: this video has too many likes
entries.context: commenting on a popular video's engagement

entries.sourcePattern: béo = fatty/greasy (false friend with 'fat' as food adjective)
entries.context: commenting on an oily or greasy dish

entries.vietlish: book a chair on the plane
entries.natural: book a seat on the plane
entries.sourcePattern: đặt ghế trên máy bay (ghế = chair/seat false friend)

entries.vietlish: how strange! I didn't know that
entries.natural: how surprising! / I had no idea!
entries.context: reacting to unexpected news with surprise

entries.vietlish: please eat fast or we will be late
entries.natural: please eat quickly or we'll be late
entries.sourcePattern: ăn nhanh lên (nhanh = fast, but 'quickly' collocates with eat)
năng động = active/energetic (active implies physical movement only in English)

entries.natural: prepare in advance for the presentation
entries.sourcePattern: chuẩn bị trước cho buổi thuyết trình (adverb-adjective placement calque)
